logline: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.

moments.description: Juliana's blood-streaked hand uncurls amidst sharp blackthorn branches to reveal the emerald signet ring.
An exhausted and scratched Juliana confronts the Police Constable, demanding her husband's release.
Alexander immediately rushes to Juliana, turning over her bloodied and lacerated hands with immense care.
Alexander scoops Juliana into his arms bridal-style, expressing deep sorrow that she had to bleed for him.
moments.key_dialogue: You should never have had to bleed for me.

moments.description: Alexander kneels before the fireplace to bandage Juliana's torn wrists while they share a tender exchange.
moments.key_dialogue: You could have lost your hands.

moments.description: Alexander makes a dark vow to protect Juliana forever as his hand clenches into an iron fist of vengeance over a bucket of blood-soaked water.
moments.key_dialogue: No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.
